boardPreviewDescription: A local preview of the fixed board and renderer controls.
boardPreviewControls: Drag to pan. Use the wheel or a two-finger pinch to zoom. Double-click or double-tap to fit the board.
boardPreviewHitTesting: Select a tile or piece location to inspect its semantic board ID.
boardPreviewLegendToken: Number tokens show their production value; 6 and 8 use red.
boardPreviewLegendPieces: Player pieces use their faction's color.
boardRendererError: The board could not be rendered. Try reloading this page.
boardKeyboardHelp: Use arrow keys to browse legal board locations, Home or End to jump, Enter to select, and Escape to leave the board.

vault.title: Local data protection
vault.description: Use a passphrase to encrypt this browser’s multiplayer identity and private game data. Protection is off by default.
vault.locked: Your saved multiplayer games are locked
vault.unlocked: Protection is on · unlocked in this tab
vault.disableHint: Your game data will remain on this browser without passphrase encryption.
vault.keepPassphrase: Use at least 12 characters and keep your passphrase somewhere safe. You will need it after reopening the browser. Hexfield cannot recover a forgotten passphrase. Your data is accessible while the game is unlocked.
vault.mismatch: The new passphrases do not match.
vault.wrongPassphrase: That passphrase did not unlock your saved data. Try again.
vault.passphraseLength: Use a passphrase between 12 and 1,024 characters.
vault.otherTab: Another Hexfield tab is still using these saves. Close it and try again.
vault.unsupported: This browser cannot coordinate protected storage safely. Use a browser that supports Web Locks.
vault.damaged: Protected data is missing or damaged. Hexfield has kept it unchanged and has not created a replacement identity.
vault.failed: Could not open or update protected data. Your saved identity has not been replaced.

pwaUpdateDescription: A new version of Hexfield is ready.
pwaBackgroundWarning: Keep Hexfield in front during online games. While this tab is in the background, your browser may pause it and disconnect you from the other players.
